title: Error-handling request queue record v1
description: One line of a strategy's append-only error-handling request queue, kept in the strategy's audit/ directory (never in /var/lib/*-control, which ops-control can write). A request names one condition that crossed a threshold and stays open until an outcome closes it. Opening a request notifies nobody; Only R2 (once escalated) and R3 conditions can open one (fleet-error-catalog/v2).

code.description: Bare condition name, never a prefixed catalog code.

risk_tier.description: fleet-error-catalog/v2 tiers. R0 and R1 are absent by construction: the action after detection is fixed or was already executed automatically, so there is nothing for a request to be about.

fingerprint.description: Deduplication key over (project, code, evidence). One condition staying true across many cycles yields one request.

event_ref.description: event_id of the fleet event log record this request was opened from, when there is one.

status.description: RESOLVED_AUTO: an automatic remedy ran (R2, or R3 after its timeout). RESOLVED_HUMAN: an operator acted. SUPERSEDED: the same condition re-opened with different evidence. WITHDRAWN: the condition stopped holding on its own.
